positions.as_written: Start at the fibular head, which is the landmark everything else is found from.
Follow the collateral ligament from the fibular head to the femoral epicondyle, reorienting as it runs obliquely.
Follow the biceps femoris to its insertion and the common peroneal nerve around the fibular neck.
